content.text: Hepatitis B Virus Infection, adolescents & adults
Adolescents & adults at ↑ risk for infection
•USPSTF recommends screening for HBV infection in adolescents & adults at ↑ risk for infection
Hepatitis B Virus Infection, pregnant women
•USPSTF recommends screening for HBV infection in pregnant women at their 1st prenatal visit
Asymptomatic adults at ↑ risk of LTBI
•USPSTF recommends screening for LTBI in populations at ↑ risk
postmenopausal women <65yo at ↑ risk for an osteoporotic fracture as estimated by clinical risk assessment
: age, low BMI, ETOH, smoker, long-term steroid use, previous factures, hx of falls in past year
•USPSTF recommends exercise interventions to prevent falls in community-dwelling adults ≥65yo at ↑ risk for falls
•USPSTF recommends screening for prediabetes & type 2 diabetes in
; optimal screening frequency undefined, some studies suggest screening q3y may be reasonable
•Offer/refer pts w/ prediabetes → effective preventive interventions
•USPSTF recommends screening for gestational diabetes in asymptomatic pregnant persons at ≥24wk gestation
Weight Loss to Prevent Obesity-Related Morbidity & Mortality
•USPSTF recommends offering/referring adults w/ BMI ≥30 to intensive, multicomponent behavioral interventions
•USPSTF recommends providing/referring children & adolescents ≥6yo w/ high BMI (≥95th percentile for age & sex) to comprehensive, intensive behavioral interventions
Healthy Weight & Weight Gain in Pregnancy
•USPSTF recommends offering pregnant persons effective behavioral counseling interventions to promote healthy weight gain & prevent excess gestational weight gain
•USPSTF recommends screening for asymptomatic bacteriuria in pregnant persons
•USPSTF strongly recommends Rh(D) blood typing & antibody testing for all pregnant women at their 1st visit for pregnancy-related care (A)
•USPSTF recommends repeat Rh(D) antibody testing for all unsensitized Rh(D)(-) women at 24-28wk gestation, unless biological father known to be Rh(D)(-) (B)
Folic Acid to Prevent Neural Tube Defects
Persons who plan to or could become pregnant
•USPSTF recommends a daily supplement w/ 0.4-0.8mg (400-800mcg) folic acid for all persons planning to or who could become pregnant
•USPSTF recommends interventions or referrals, during pregnancy & after birth, to support breastfeeding
•USPSTF recommends applying fluoride varnish to the primary teeth of all infants & children starting at primary tooth eruption
•USPSTF recommends oral fluoride supplementation starting @6mo for children whose water supply is deficient in fluoride
•USPSTF recommends vision screening ≥1x in all children 3-5yo to detect amblyopia or its RFs
